proposals.name: Momentum-Volume Asymmetry Tensor

proposals.name: Short-Horizon Reversal vs Volume Shock
proposals.rationale: Intraday candlestick morphology interacts with volume shocks to define short-term reversal strength; residual variance along this axis should predict 1-day IC.

proposals.name: Volatility-of-Volatility Regime Tensor
proposals.rationale: Regime shifts in volatility-of-volatility change the cross-sectional dispersion of returns; encoding this jointly with trend R^2 gives a rank-rich kernel direction.

proposals.name: Order-Flow Lead-Lag vs Price Trend
proposals.rationale: Volume-price lead-lag beta captures informed trading; when aligned with trend slope it isolates directional order-flow that predicts cross-sectional returns.

proposals.name: Tail Asymmetry x Path Efficiency
proposals.rationale: Fat-tail asymmetry combined with path efficiency distinguishes crash-prone from grind-up names; residual energy along this direction should improve ranking in volatile regimes.

proposals.name: Multi-Scale Momentum Spread
proposals.rationale: Divergence between fast and slow momentum proxies cross-sectional reversal vs continuation; encoding the spread plus volatility conditioning yields high-rank kernel.

proposals.name: Candlestick Body vs Volume Imbalance
proposals.rationale: KBar body-to-shadow ratio times volume imbalance is a microstructure signal for next-day reversal; distinct from trend channels so it adds rank.

proposals.name: Correlation Regime Shift Tensor
proposals.rationale: Cross-sectional price-volume correlation regime shifts precede dispersion changes; combining corr_half with trend slope and vol asymmetry gives a rank-rich kernel.

proposals.name: Hurst Proxy x Order-Flow Beta
proposals.rationale: Persistence (Hurst) interacts with order-flow beta to identify trend-following vs contrarian regimes; weakly correlated with pure momentum channels.

proposals.name: Intraday Shadow Reversal Tensor
proposals.rationale: Upper/lower shadow asymmetry predicts intraday reversal; combined with short-lag price acceleration and volume kurtosis it yields a distinct rank direction.

proposals.name: Long-Horizon Trend R2 vs Volume Vol

proposals.name: Price-VWAP Spread x Volume Shock

proposals.name: Skew-Kurtosis Tail Tensor

proposals.name: Semivar Ratio Primitive

proposals.name: Vol-Price Corr Primitive

proposals.name: Path Efficiency Primitive

proposals.name: Hurst Variance Ratio Primitive

proposals.name: Lead-Lag Beta Primitive

proposals.name: Tail Asymmetry Primitive

proposals.name: Regime Transition Primitive

Your objective is to construct mathematically rigorous relational predicates P(X) for the LUSI (Learning Using Statistical Invariants) loss on the CSI300 daily Alpha158 stock panel:
    L(y, y_hat) = tau_hat * ||y - y_hat||_I^2 + tau * (y - y_hat)^T P(X) (y - y_hat)
where batch_x has shape [B, T=20, F=158], phi(X) in R^(B x d) is standardized per column and normalized to unit Frobenius norm, and P(X) = phi_hat(X) @ phi_hat(X)^T.

1. Non-Collapse / High Effective Rank Gate:
   Every candidate is tested on a real CSI300 batch before training. If participation-ratio effective rank r_eff(P) = (tr(P))^2 / ||P||_F^2 < 1.25 or off-diagonal cosine alignment with 11^T/B > 0.98, the kernel collapses to the trivial global shrinkage control (`control:ones`) and is REJECTED.
   Therefore, design descriptors with d >= 3 diverse, weakly correlated dimensions!
2. Beat Both MSE Baseline and `control:ones`:
   A candidate is only validated if paired Delta_IC > min_effect, its 95% block-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0, AND it outperforms `control:ones`.
3. Alpha158 Feature Subspace Map (feature_dim=158, valid slice [start, end] with 0 <= start < end <= 158 and end - start >= 2):
   - [0, 9]: KBar intraday candlestick morphology (body, upper/lower shadow, shift)
